description: This script automates benchmarking of CLI startup times and memory usage, comparing current results against baseline fixtures, and reports regressions. It includes command-line argument parsing, report file handling, and comparison logic.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as milliseconds string with one decimal place.

methods.name: formatMb
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as megabytes string with one decimal place.

methods.name: resolveCurrentReportPath
methods.description: Determines the path for current benchmark report, generating report if needed.

methods.name: indexCases
methods.description: Creates a map from case ID to case data for easier access.
